headline: Kai, Washington gets Xi on Thursday, and markets are already trading the handshake — futures up, oil down, the 10-year back under 5 percent.
subline: The Fed's first hike since 2023 keeps digesting, SoftBank borrows $11 billion to double down on OpenAI, and bitcoin holds above $81,000 after the SEC's tokenization green light.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:35 AM ET · equity figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: One hike done, another penciled in
items.sentence: The September move to 3.75–4.00 percent was the Fed's first hike since July 2023, and median projections leave room for one more this year, per TradingKey.

items.title: The 10-year steps back from 5 percent
items.sentence: Trading Economics has the yield at 4.96 percent early Monday, off about four basis points, after last week's Fed-driven climb to a 19-year high.

items.title: Oil gives back some war premium
items.sentence: WTI slipped about 2 percent to $94.12 and gold eased to $4,385 as summit diplomacy softened the risk bid, per Yahoo Finance's live blog.

items.title: The week's data test the Fed's hike
items.sentence: Kiplinger's calendar shows flash September PMIs Wednesday, then durable goods and the final Michigan sentiment reading Friday — the first broad look at activity since the Fed tightened.

items.title: Retail earnings week runs AutoZone through Costco
items.sentence: AutoZone reports Tuesday and Costco's fiscal fourth quarter lands after Thursday's close, with General Mills and Darden in between, per TradingKey.

items.title: Xi comes to Washington on Thursday
items.sentence: TradingKey reports a September 24 summit spanning tariffs, tech export controls, rare earths, AI and farm trade, with pre-summit consultations already under way in New York.

items.title: Taiwan, technology, trade — and a state dinner
items.sentence: The National reports a pending $14 billion Taiwan arms package hanging over the table, tech chiefs from Bezos to Jensen Huang invited to the state dinner, and analysts expecting no big breakthroughs.

items.title: Trump takes the Iran case to the world
items.sentence: Fox News's live coverage has Trump pressing the case that Iran cannot get a nuclear weapon, with Strait of Hormuz security and gas prices shadowing the midterm season.

items.title: Government funding is settled into December
items.sentence: Congress passed a stopgap earlier this month that funds the government until December, averting a pre-election shutdown, per The Hill.

items.title: SoftBank borrows $11 billion for its OpenAI bet
items.sentence: The Japan Times reports SoftBank is seeking more than $11 billion in junk bonds to fund its next OpenAI tranche, which AI Weekly's roundup says lifts its total commitment toward $65 billion.

items.title: Anthropic pushes its IPO to November
items.sentence: Annualized revenue is nearing $100 billion ahead of a listing now slated for November, per Bloomberg's read of the New York Times.

items.title: House China hawk presses Trump on chip curbs
items.sentence: Rep. John Moolenaar urged tighter chip rules and closed cloud loopholes before the summit, even as Treasury floats a US-China AI-incident notification channel, per AI Weekly's roundup.

items.title: Washington's AI divide: Nvidia versus the labs
items.sentence: CNBC reports a regulatory split that puts the Trump administration and Nvidia on one side and OpenAI and Anthropic on the other over how far AI rules should reach.

items.title: Bitcoin clears $82,000 on the tokenization trade
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades near $81,800 after touching $82,000 — up about 2 percent overnight, extending the run that began with Friday's SEC tokenized-stock clearance, per Benzinga and Yahoo Finance.
